scenes.name: laundry room overview
scenes.desc: The entrance of the laundry room, there's an office room on the left side, and two rows of washing and drying machines in the front. Each side of the room has a corridor. There's also a vending machine right in front of you.

items.position: Hanging on the wall in the front

states.desc: An old vending machine with three items on the list, each worth 0.5 dollar, The machine only receives coins.
states.neg_reward: You may put your coins at hand to see what will come out. Make sure you have already exchanged the money to coins.

transitions.reward: A soap drop out from the machine, and returns you some coins. You have 1.5 dollars remaining.

tools.position: In the output box of vending machine

states.desc: a brand new soap, white and very slippery, might be used to lubricate things

scenes.name: left corridor overview
scenes.desc: The left corridor of the laundry room. A row of drying machine is now on your right. There's an office door on the left. The corridor leads to a game booth.

items.position: On the right of the corridor

states.desc: The drying machine with lid closed now. There's a money receiver (coin only) on the right, and a control panel now showing 1.5 dollar.
states.neg_reward: It only receives coins of exact amount, you should put in the coin if you have exactly total amount 1.5 dollars at hand.

transitions.reward: The lid of the machine opens, and there's a yellow key card inside.

states.desc: The drying machine, now with the lid open.

items.position: Hanging on the wall left of office door

states.desc: The mail box is locked with a 4-digit password. The hint beside the lock writes 'II I I/II I-II', corresponding to the 4 digits.
states.neg_reward: You should try to figure the code out by first knowing what I and II represents, find hints about it.

transitions.reward: The mail box opens, and there drops a safe handle.

states.desc: The mail box is open.
The paper writes "1 4 2 3 +", seems left part of an equation hint. Find its right part to form the whole hint.
states.neg_reward: You cannot take it with you, but you may remember it and combine it with another hint to complete it.

items.position: Hanging on the wall right of office door

states.desc: The pad requires to input a 4-digit number to open the office door.
states.neg_reward: Try to get the paper pieces that hint on this 4-digit code, you may need to combine two hints in your bag together.

trigger: change_visible, scene, office room overview, True
transitions.reward: The office door opens, you could get in now.

states.desc: a yellow key card with a small round metal disk on its head, seems used to open something
a silver safe handle made of metal

scenes.name: end of left corridor
scenes.desc: There's a game booth on the left, and drying machine still on your right. In the front is a vacant space with air vent hanging high above and green plant below.

states.desc: A fancy game machine currently turned on, with 'insert ticket' written on the screen.
states.neg_reward: You may find a ticket to run the game and play it.

transitions.reward: You start playing the game. You achieve top 1 and the screen shows your score is 5974.

states.desc: The screen shows you achieve top 1 with a score of 5974.

items.position: On the ground beside drying machine

states.desc: A red tool box with a 4-digit password lock. There's only 4 choices 1, 2, 3 or 4 for each digit, e.g. 2343 (just example input, not correct).
states.neg_reward: You should only use 1, 2, 3, 4 in your password input. Use the equation hint to solve this.

transitions.reward: The tool box is open, there's a nozzle inside

states.desc: The tool box is now open.
A silver metal pipe tightened on the drying machine, originally used to deliver water.
states.neg_reward: You may want to use the pipe later, try to get it off with tool in your bag.

transitions.reward: The pipe is unscrewed from the machine, you can collect it now.

items.position: High on the wall in the front

states.desc: A white air vent, it's too high to be reached now.
states.neg_reward: You should put something on the ground to try to reach the vent.

transitions.reward: You could now reach the vent.

states.desc: A white air vent, now you could reach it. There's a port beside, with fresh air coming out, seems used for filling.
states.neg_reward: The air vent could help fill in gas, but something used to deliver gas should be installed to the container first.

transitions.reward: The gas tank is now filled with gas, the air pressure is enough now.

states.desc: A white air vent, now continuously giving fresh air.
a nozzle with a silver mouth, seems should connect with something else to control and work.
a silver metal pipe with that could connect ends together

scenes.name: laundry room left corner
scenes.desc: The left corner of the laundry room. There's a coffee table in the corner, some newspaper on the coffee table, and a drink vending machine beside.

states.desc: a game ticket that writes 'car racing', made of normal paper

scenes.name: laundry room right corner
scenes.desc: The right corner of the laundry room. There's a row of seats beside the wall, a green plant at the corner. The floor is clean.

states.desc: The zip of the handbag is rusty, hard to open directly.
states.neg_reward: You may find a way to lubricate the zip before opening it.

transitions.reward: The zip is now lubricated with soap foam all over it.

states.desc: The zip of the handbag is all over soap foam, easy to open now.
states.neg_reward: You may simply interact with the bag to open it.

transitions.reward: You open the handbag, and there's a piler inside.

states.desc: The hand bag is now open.

items.position: Hanging on the right side wall

states.desc: An information board has a lock on outer glass door. There's a lock at the bottom requiring 4-digit password. On the wall writes 'top 1'.
states.neg_reward: You should think about what 4-digit hint is related to top 1 and hints related to it.

trigger: change_visible, tool, left half paper, True
transitions.reward: The window of the information board is now open. There's lots of notice inside.

states.desc: The information board is now open.
A pot culture, green plant growing in the soil. The soil seems a bit loose.
states.neg_reward: You may find out what's inside the soil by simply interacting with it.

transitions.reward: You dig into the soil and find a gold key hidden beneath.

states.desc: A pot culture with soild being digged.

items.position: On the wall in the front

states.desc: A hanger made of wood, a rag haning on it. The bolts seems a bit loose.
states.neg_reward: There may be something behind, you may further pull the hanger down (loose the screw) with a tool.

transitions.reward: The hanger is pulled down, and there's a piece of paper inside the wall behind.

states.desc: A hanger currently pulled down, showing a hidden space behind.
A money exchange machine that gives coins according to input bill amount.
states.neg_reward: You may input money and get coins from here. You should do it after the bill is dry.

transitions.reward: Two coins come out the machine, each worth 1 dollar.

states.desc: A money exchanger that works normally.
a piler with red handle and metal head

tools.position: Inside the soil of pot culture

states.desc: Two coins, each worth 1 dollar. In total 2 dollars.

scenes.desc: The right corridor of the laundry room. There's a row of drying machine on your left now, and a row of washing machine on your right. The corridor leads to a table in the front.

states.desc: A blue basin with water inside.
states.neg_reward: You could soak things inside this basin.

transitions.reward: The clothes is now wet after soaking in the water.

tools.position: Inside the blue basin on drying machine

states.desc: a wet 2 dollar bill, still intact, but cannot be used if not dry
a dry 2 dollar bill, now usable
a white shirt currenly clean and dry

scenes.desc: There's a table right in fron of you. A door is on the left but locked. A TV is hanging high above the wall in the corner.

states.desc: The plug with a electric cable, not in the socket beside now.
states.neg_reward: You may simply interact to get the plug into the socket to power on things above the table.
